Who the hell do ya work for…? Haven't you done enuff...? 'Bout time... ya spit it out...
你们到底是哪里来的……现在总能……说了吧……

We…
我们是……

... are from Limbus Company.
边狱公司来的。

Finally. One less millstone ‘round the neck.
可算是把这话说出来了。

dataList.content:
That doesn't... help at all...! The hell is "Limbus Company" supposed to be...?!
所以……你说的……到底是哪里啊……！

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Oh, just for your reference—Effie and I work in a different department. Please don’t lump us in with these people.
啊，顺带一提，我和埃菲跟这些人可不是一个部门的。请不要混为一谈哦。

dataList.content:
Beaten in more ways than one, the man finally collapsed on the ground—the sheer frustration at our aversion to communicating normally must've contributed to his fainting spell, too.
那个被叫做帮主的人会晕倒，很大程度上是因为与我们的对话过于让人恼火了吧。

My condolences to whatever remained of the poor fellow's patience.
可以的话我真想好好安慰他。

Do we seriously have to wear these clothes, though? Stuff reeks of sweat and blood and... ugh, just gross.
不过我们真得穿上这衣服吗？这上面全是汗味和血味……还有一股霉味，恶心死了。

Rodya held up a shirt stripped from a Tingtang member with just two fingers as though she were handling a particularly repulsive piece of garbage.
罗佳像捡垃圾一样拈起从豆豆帮身上剥下的衬衫，抱怨道。

Yuck, there's hair on it, too... First time I've ever been jealous of Dante not having eyes.
唔，还沾着毛……我还是第一次这么羡慕但丁没有眼睛。

<My vision's working fine, you know...>
<我看得见……>

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
The material looks... pretty quality, actually. Guess business was better than I thought.
质量……看起来比想象中要好啊？这些家伙的生意兴许比我以为的更好。

I want that. Hand it over.
跟我换。拿来。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
I-I can't. It's tailor-made.
这、这是量身定做的衣服，所以不行啊。

<… The label here says "Fits all sizes.">
<……可标签上写的是均码。>

Catching my gaze lingering on the label, Effie snapped:
埃菲注意到我一直盯着他衣服上的标签，突然火冒三丈。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Ngh... W-we wouldn’t be doing any of this if you hadn’t caused that mess in the pawnshop to begin with!
呼……要、要不是你们在当铺那里惹事，我们哪里还会这么辛苦。

I don’t mind. I’ve always wanted to try on clothes like these. It’s like we’re filming a movie.
没关系。我一直想穿这种衣服，哪怕就一次也行。简直像是在拍电影一样。

To be honest, I’m a little nervous. It’s been a while since I’ve worked in disguise.
我有点紧张，因为很久没有伪装潜入过了。

I don’t feel like it. This is some wimpy crap.
我可不喜欢。这是懦夫之举。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Sorry, but can someone please keep her mouth shut?
抱歉，请问有谁能让这人闭嘴吗？

*scoff* You're welcome to try so long as you don't mind getting sliced up all the way past the ribs.
……如果你做好被砍断肋骨的觉悟的话，大可以试试。

Gregor’s calm riposte drew a round of muffled laughter from the Sinners.
听见格里高尔的低声回敬，罪人们都窃笑了起来。

For a moment, Effie and Saude hesitated, unsure how to take the quip...
而埃菲和索德，都露出了不知该如何理解这句话的表情……

Until they moved on, probably because they decided it wasn't worth mulling over. Effie then raised a small container that seemed to be inlaid with mother-of-pearl.
不过他们很快便觉得这根本无关紧要，便恢复了表情，拿起了一个似乎是螺钿的小盒子。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
… This is a Wish Canister we seized from the Tingtang Gang’s boss.
……这是我们从豆豆帮的帮主手里拿到的愿望罐。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Manager, here’s a simple role you can play.
经理，有个简单的任务要交给你。

<What role...?>
<你在说……？>

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Judging by your confused gestures, I suppose you're in need of some explanation.
看你那副不知道我们在说什么的样子，我们似乎有必要解释一下。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
The long and short of it is that this thing contains J Corp’s Singularity. It's a tool that siphons people's "wishes" and stores them as energy.
可以说这个罐子中有着J公司的奇点。它是能够吸取人们的“愿望”并将其以能量形式储存的工具。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
And when the time comes to make use of it, you press that Wishpower onto paper, and voilà! You get a single-use sticker tattoo that boosts your luck high enough to touch the sky!
只要在合适的时机抽出一张纸状的愿望，锵锵！一张贴上就能带来好运的一次性纹身贴就会出现。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Looks like Tingtang Gang's plan was to win the game on the top floor by scraping luck from other people… Hard to believe a small-time gang boss managed to get his hands on one of these.
看来他们在搜刮别人的运气，然后拿下顶层的赌局……区区一介地痞老大竟然有着这样的东西。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Manager… Dante, right? Okay, before we head inside... I want you to hold on to this.
经理……你是叫但丁吧？在我们进入赌场时由你来保管它。

<You sure you want to entrust me with something that important?>
<把这么重要的任务交给我真的行吗？>

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
You're not exactly radiating confidence, sure, but we do have our reasons for assigning you to this task.
虽然你看上去没什么自信，但指定你是有理由的。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
First off, keeping a poker face is essential at any gambling table.
第一。在赌博中最重要的是有一张扑克脸。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
No matter how good they are at reading expressions, they can't read emotional cues off a clock.
不论是多么善于察言观色的家伙，都没法读出钟表的表情。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Secondly, I do believe there's a reason you were chosen as manager.
第二，我觉得你成为经理是有一定理由的。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Call it a hunch, but something tells me you’ll be more useful than those Sinners you lead.
模糊的直觉告诉我，你会比那些罪人们更有用。

Come to think of it... he wasn't wrong.
想想也确实如此。

I was given the title of manager, but never had a chance to be the charismatic leader I’d envisioned. Instead, I was mocked, threatened, and ignored by the very same Sinners I was supposed to supervise.
我虽然以经理的头衔入职，但别说散发领袖魅力了，反倒时常被罪人们威胁与无视，

The only real role I was able to carry out so far was to bring them back to life.
除了复活他们以外，连一件像样的任务都没有交给我过。

Whenever the Sinners fought our enemies, sweating and bleeding, all I could do was cower behind them and pray that their heads and hearts would remain intact just so I wouldn't have to go through the pain of reviving them.
当罪人们在前线汗流浃背地战斗时，我只能在后方焦急地祈祷他们的心脏或者大脑不会被流弹贯穿。

With a heavy heart, I nodded to let Effie know I was ready.
我怀着沉重的心情点了点头。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Alright. Now put this on your arm. With this, you can become the luckiest person in the City for a short while.
好了。把这个贴在胳膊上。此后的一小段时间内，你就是全世界最幸运的人。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
As for the rest of you, you’ll act as Tingtangers, and we’ll be the croupiers. Good luck and break a leg!
很好，各位就是豆豆帮，我们就是荷官。全力完成各自的工作吧。

Vowing to see this mission through no matter what,
于是我们抱着一定要让这次作战成功的决心，

we pushed open the door leading into the casino.
打开了赌场的大门。
